description: Register a camera/NVR/stream as a capture source (C4 Open Capture). provider is a registry key (RTSP, HTTP_SNAPSHOT, ONVIF, GO2RTC, FRIGATE, ...); plane CLOUD captures server-side (SSRF-guarded), AGENT is captured by a paired LAN agent; frames land in the Open Label dataset in destination, content-deduped with lineage. An optional credential (user:password) is encrypted at rest and never returned. Requires capture:write.
name: opentrain_capture_source_create
